description.fun: Tauros whips itself into a frenzy with its three tails, and once it starts charging it can't stop or turn until it hits something, smashing through boulders on the way. The herd's protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns. People all over the world have ridden Tauros, a practice said to have started in Alola. In Red and Green its Pokédex entry said it had two tails; FireRed and LeafGreen fixed it to three.
description.guide: A brown, bull-like Normal Pokémon with three tails, which is male-only, does not evolve and is often seen as a counterpart of Miltank. In Paldea it has a regional form in three breeds: Combat (Fighting), Blaze (Fighting and Fire) and Aqua (Fighting and Water).
description.tagline: A three-tailed bull that can't stop once it charges

names.ja: パルデア ケンタロス

description.fun: Paldea's black Tauros, inspired by the Spanish fighting bull, is the only Pokémon with three regional forms in one region. The Combat Breed is pure muscle and aggression, using its short horns to strike at a foe's weak spots.

names.ja: パルデア ケンタロス

description.fun: The Blaze Breed breathes hot air from its nostrils, and when it attacks, its horns glow red and heat past 1,000°C, so anyone it gores is burned as well as wounded.

names.ja: パルデア ケンタロス

description.fun: The Aqua Breed's body fat keeps it afloat, and it swims by firing high-pressure jets of water from its horns and bending its tails into a propeller. The same jets can pierce right through an enemy.
